query: Set up builder environments for our 5-person sales team — they want to build CRM dashboards
expected_behavior: Loads reference/phase1-requirements.md and asks about audience experience, AI tools (Copilot vs Claude Code vs OpenCode), and SSO
Creates a custom RBAC role 'Builder' with project-scoped permissions per reference/phase2-foundation.md
Chooses one of the three Dockerfile templates from templates/dockerfiles/ (likely VS Code Server for low-code builders) and provisions the IDE container
Sets per-builder isolation (project-per-builder) and applies TTL stop+delete jobs from templates/scripts/
Outputs a builder-platform-config.yaml so the qovery-builder-portal skill can pick up the setup

query: Generate the Terraform manifests for our builder platform
expected_behavior: Copies templates/terraform/{variables,main,terraform.tfvars}.tf and the modules/builder-env/main.tf module into the user's repo
Does NOT regenerate Terraform code from scratch — the templates are the source of truth
Substitutes the user's specific values (org id, cluster id, blueprint env id) into terraform.tfvars
Reminds the user to run `terraform plan` before `terraform apply`

query: Add a TTL of 8 hours so workspaces auto-stop at end of day
expected_behavior: Copies templates/scripts/ttl-stop-job.sh and adapts the TTL constant
Creates a Qovery cron job from the script with a daily schedule (e.g. weekdays 8pm)
Stores the platform API token as a job secret
Optionally suggests pairing it with the delete job (templates/scripts/ttl-delete-job.sh) so workspaces stopped for >7 days are reclaimed
